plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Computer Science - Software Development Concentration 8-semester degree plan (2026-2027 Catalog), 'Version 2026/2/17', Caver College of Aviation, Science, and Nursing. Header states it is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 15+16+15+15+16+15+15+13 = 120. Graduation requirements printed on the plan: overall GPA 2.00+, all major courses C or better, at least 42 junior/senior hours, minor requirements completed, one Writing Intensive (WI) course, at least 120 total hours earned; students are responsible for adding courses if needed to meet hour/financial-aid requirements. 'PR = pre-requisite.' ENGL 10203 lists 'PR: ENG 1463' (prior numbering; satisfied in-plan by ENGL 10103 Freshman English A). Choice slots (first-listed code shown): Sophomore Spring US History/American Govt. (PLSC 20003 / PLSC 200H3 / HIST 21103 / HIST 21203); Junior Spring MATH 21003 Statistical Methods or BIOS 20503 Applied Biostatistics. Lecture/lab pairs (e.g. CSCE 10104/10100) carry one combined credit value; lecture code shown with lab noted. 'Social Science', 'Humanities', 'Free Elective/Minor', 'Minor Course', 'Minor Course / Free Elective', 'Natural Science with Lab', 'Jr/Sr Computer Science Elective (CPSI, CSCE)', and 'Jr/Sr Elective in Minor' name only the slot, not a course: ELECTIVE placeholders with choice=true. Senior Spring 'Jr/Sr Elective in Minor' is 4 credits (kept verbatim; 3 credits in other terms). The course descriptions appended to the PDF use pre-2026 course numbers (e.g. CSC 1104) and are reference only, not part of the sequence.
